ModMetaData.name: Remember Me?
ModMetaData.author: frbyyy
ModMetaData.description:
Colonists from your old games are not gone. Once in a while one of them turns up in your new world.
Remember Me? reads your old saves in the background and keeps an archive of every colonist who ever lived in them, alive or dead. With a small chance, a pawn the game is about to create (a raider, a visitor, a trader, a wanderer, a refugee, a castaway in a crashed pod, a prisoner waiting for rescue, a wild man, a sleeper in an ancient casket, the people of a camp you raid, a slave for sale, a new faction leader) becomes one of those people instead: same name, face, traits, skills, backstory, genes and prosthetics.
Where they end up depends on who they were. Former ideology leaders and nobles tend to lead factions, veterans with many kills turn up in raids, merchants run caravans, tribal colonists join tribes, xenohumans join their own kind. Children from old colonies come back grown up.
Colonists who died get their own way back: they may walk in and ask to join, and with Anomaly they may come as a creepjoiner, shamble in among the dead or crash down as a ghoul.
Each returning colonist tells a story of the years in between: shipwrecks and pirate cages, caravans and tribes, burned colonies, grudges, faiths and ambitions, and for the dead, mostly silence. Optionally (experimental) they bear the marks of it: old scars and a new trait.
Works with Vanilla Skills Expanded: its passions and expertise come back with the colonist, and turn into vanilla skill levels and passions when VSE is not loaded.
Settings: chances, cooldown, letters and stories on or off, which roles are used and how often, which old colonies count, the Remember button on or off.
---
Колонисты из ваших старых игр никуда не делись. Иногда кто-то из них появляется в новом мире: гостем, торговцем, рейдером, беженцем, потерпевшим крушение, пленником, одичавшим, спящим в древней криптокапсуле, обитателем вражеского лагеря, рабом на продажу, лидером фракции или новым членом колонии. Кем станет человек, зависит от его прошлой жизни. Погибшие возвращаются отдельным событием, а с Anomaly приходят жутким странником, бродячим мертвецом или гулем в упавшей капсуле. Каждый вернувшийся рассказывает историю своих лет между жизнями, а по желанию (экспериментально) несёт её следы: старые шрамы и новую черту. Совместим с Vanilla Skills Expanded: страсти и экспертность переносятся, а без VSE превращаются в обычные уровни навыков и страсти.
